newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on strong yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on strong yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Friday, weighed down by the yen's gains against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen to 0.7 yen per kg lower.
Benchmark October closed 0.4 yen lower at 139.6 yen.
Activity was lacklustre as the market continued to suffer a lack of market moving factors barring the currency market.

"Market players were watching for signs of direction in the currency market, to see whether the yen's strong tone will continue for a longer period of time," one analyst at a commodity broker said. --Tokyo Commodity Desk, +81-3-3432-7431
